title: Oracle Midday Brief
script_summary: Extreme fear at 27 clashes with Bitcoin’s 1.2 percent rise to 64,690 dollars. Hashrate holds firm at 880 EH/s, confirming miner conviction. Mempool sits at 94,000 transactions while fees stay suppressed at 2 sat/vB, showing orderly flow. Block 961,191 advances without incident. US morning session delivers modest gains against persistent caution.
